evals.prompt: Create a custom inspection checklist form element in VertiGIS Workflow SDK decomposed according to the 7-directory blueprint.
evals.expected_output: A custom form element decomposed into sub-components, custom hooks, tokens, and utils, staying strictly under the 150-line ceiling per file.
expectations: Orchestrator file (main.tsx) stays strictly under 150 lines
Uses 7-directory decomposition (components/, hooks/, tokens/, utils/, types/)
Enforces minimum 44x44px touch targets on interactive mobile controls
Uses @mui/material Typography with semantic color tokens rather than raw HTML tags
Wraps layout in an ErrorBoundary or FormElementErrorBoundary

evals.prompt: Implement a custom workflow activity that computes drive-time catchment areas and provides a dropdown input for travel mode.
evals.expected_output: A TypeScript workflow activity implementing execute with inline union dropdown types and defensive error handling.
expectations: Dropdown input property uses inline union type (e.g., travelMode: 'driving' | 'walking' | string)
Execution block is wrapped in try/catch and throws structured errors
ArcGIS class modules use default imports (e.g., import Graphic from '@arcgis/core/Graphic')

evals.prompt: Run initiate to configure AGENTS.md with VertiGIS Workflow SDK directives.
evals.expected_output: Execution or recommendation of initiate_agents_md.py injecting workflow SDK directives.
expectations: Directives are bounded by <!-- vertigis-workflow-sdk:start --> and <!-- vertigis-workflow-sdk:end -->
